logline: 난파로 무인도에 홀로 남겨진 남자가, 아무것도 없는 곳에서 살림을 하나씩 세운다.
destination: 섬의 모래밭 — 그가 혼자가 아님을 알게 되는 자리
protagonist: 덥수룩한 수염에 염소 가죽 옷을 걸친 중년 남자
anchor: a bearded middle-aged man in rough goatskin clothes and a tall goatskin cap
palette: bleached sand, turquoise shallows, deep jungle green, driftwood grey

beats.beat: 남자가 부서진 배의 널판을 붙잡고 파도에 밀린다.
beats.visual: a man clinging to a broken ship plank as surf drives him toward a wide empty beach
beats.motion: the wave carries him forward onto the sand, foam boils past, the plank pitches

beats.beat: 남자가 난파선에서 궤짝을 뗏목에 옮겨 싣는다.
beats.visual: a man loading crates from a wrecked ship's deck onto a makeshift raft in shallow water
beats.motion: a crate swings down onto the raft, ropes strain, the hull groans and settles

beats.beat: 남자가 절벽 아래 울타리를 둘러 세운다.
beats.visual: a man driving sharpened stakes into sand below a limestone cliff, tent and cave mouth behind
beats.motion: the stake is hammered down into the sand, sand sprays out, the tent canvas snaps

beats.beat: 남자가 염소 떼를 울타리 안으로 몬다.
beats.visual: a goatskin-clad man herding wild goats through a gap in a stake fence, sea beyond
beats.motion: the goats push forward through the gap, dust lifts, his staff swings behind them

beats.visual: a bearded man hollowing a felled tree trunk with an adze at the jungle edge
beats.motion: the adze bites down into the trunk, chips fly outward, palm fronds toss overhead

beats.visual: a lone bare human footprint pressed into wet sand, a bearded man halted above it
beats.motion: he stops short above the print, his shadow falls across it, foam slides up the sand

beats.beat: 남자가 절벽 위에서 먼바다의 연기를 본다.
beats.visual: a bearded man on a cliff edge staring at a thread of smoke rising from a far shore
beats.motion: smoke climbs from the far shore, wind drives his cap brim back, grass flattens

beats.beat: 텅 빈 모래밭에 발자국과 파도만 남는다.
beats.visual: an empty stretch of wet beach with a single footprint, surf running up the sand at dusk
beats.motion: surf runs up over the sand toward the print, foam recedes, light fades on the water

withheld: 발자국의 주인과, 남자가 섬을 떠나게 되는 마지막
